notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ended 2025-08-31). Governmental funds from Exhibit III total column (pp5, 7); beginning/ending cash is the governmental funds total fund balance (all cash plus county treasurer balance). Bond proceeds 14,950,000 are in debt_proceeds; printed Total Receipts 21,287,403.10 includes them. Transfers 144,666.25 (General to Activities 70,000 and School Nutrition 74,666.25). Balance sheet (re-check 3): taken from the governmental funds statement (Exhibit III, Total Governmental Funds column: assets p7, fund balances by classification p9) because its totals equal the government-wide Statement of Net Position (Exhibit I p1: 17,562,281.80, liabilities 0.00); county treasurers' balance is cash held by the county treasurers (Schedule N). No business-type funds (school nutrition is presented in governmental funds). Detail: General Fund disbursements use Schedule M (object detail by program, more detailed) and not Schedule B; Schedule M total 5,054,392.00 includes transfers 144,666.25 (shown as other financing, signed). Schedule M program lines 3535/3540/3551 are State Categorical Programs and 6200-6992 Federal Programs, following the statement's own State Programs 56,221.91 / Federal Programs 165,387.89 lines. General Fund receipts from Schedule A; blank-actual budget-only lines (3155, 4519, 1790, 2900-700, 3100-700, 2630 salaries/benefits/other items, 1200 other items, zero-amount lines 6990/6997/6998, Bond Fund 8000-911 transfer 0.00) omitted. Schedule N (county treasurer general fund) not recorded as detail to avoid double counting with Schedule A; Schedule B and Schedule N skipped. Schedule H (Bond Fund) and Schedule D disbursements print no total line so no detail_totals for those. Depreciation fund 5200 allocation from General Fund (725,000) is printed as a receipt, not a transfer, in Exhibit III; recorded as a transfer since re-check 6, see below (the General Fund 2710 Property line 736,656.00 vs budget 265,000 may hold it, but no page shows that). Re-check 3: Local Receipts property tax split from penalties & interest (1100 vs 1140 lines); State Receipts 2,369,912.79 split into Homestead Exemption, Property Tax Credit and Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate using Schedule A (p11) and Schedule I (p20), remainder state aid; 2230 Instruction - Related Technology moved to support services (Staff). Earlier recheck: Local Receipts split by fund schedules (GF Schedule A, Special Building Schedule I, Activities Schedule F); Other Expenses and Services split by fund schedules (Special Building, Depreciation, Employee Benefit). County Receipts split by Schedule A (2110 fines 27,799.97, 2210 ESU 2,059.72). Re-check 4 (2026-10-28 verifier fixes): School Nutrition 1620 Non Reimbursable 3,893.00 (p18) is non-reimbursable meal sales, counted in Exhibit III 'Sales of Meals', so category School Lunch Sales (was reimbursements/refunds); 1630 Special Functions Reimbursement kept as printed (reimbursements/refunds); stale 'categorized as instruction' review notes removed from the State Programs / Federal Programs statement lines (they are State Categorical Programs / Federal Programs as printed). Re-check 6 (2026-10-29, same fix as Blue Hill): the Depreciation Fund 5200 'Allocation from General Fund' 725,000 (Schedule C p15; Exhibit III Depreciation column Non-Revenue Receipts p4) is an interfund allocation, not revenue: it uses code 5200, the transfer code the Activities/Nutrition 'Transfers From General Fund' lines also use. It is moved out of receipts: Non-Revenue Receipts is now 51,836.30 (General Fund 607.06 + Employee Benefit 51,229.24; split_from the p5 line), and transfers_in = 144,666.25 + 725,000 = 869,666.25. The General Fund prints no 725,000 transfer (8000 Transfers 144,666.25 only, p28; Exhibit III Transfers 144,666.25 p6), so its outflow sits inside an unidentified General Fund disbursement line. Every printed line is kept as printed, with one contra disbursement -725,000 (review), and transfers_out = 144,666.25 + 725,000 = 869,666.25. Detail: Schedule C allocation is now an other-financing Transfers In (+725,000; Schedule C revenue total includes other financing); Schedule M has a contra expenditure -725,000 and a Transfers Out -725,000. Printed totals unchanged (reported_totals includes_split 725,000 on both sides); the earlier one-sided-allocation report_discrepancy is replaced by this treatment. Read pages 1-29 of 29.
